1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 g6 5..strategy: Prepares to castle and keeps the pieces compact. A quiet set-up rather than an attack, in which White waits for Black to commit.
Develops with an attack on e4 and prepares to castle, after which the freeing ...d5 break is only one move away. A natural, harmonious set-up.
